Definition: Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jekamiah is the name of two Israelites, a son of Shallum and a son of Jeconiah. In 1 Chronicles 2:41, Shallum begat Jekamiah. The fuller story is told on the Jekamiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jekamiah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
